profiles.title: General dictation
profiles.audience: Everyday users who dictate messages, notes, search queries, and short instructions.
normalization_goals: Preserve ordinary language without converting common words into domain terms.
Fix spacing, obvious ASR punctuation words, and safe casing only when confidence is high.
Avoid developer-specific replacements such as test, log, Cursor, Rust, or API.
example_inputs: сделай заметку что завтра встреча в десять

profiles.title: Developer prompts
profiles.audience: Developers and vibe coders dictating prompts to Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, terminals, PRs, and issue trackers.
normalization_goals: Normalize Russian-spoken dev terms into canonical English forms.
Preserve critical constraints and negations such as не трогай, не меняй, не добавляй.
Normalize common agent workflow commands and test/build commands.
Assemble high-confidence spoken filenames from known stems and extensions.
example_inputs: найди почему падает тест не трогай публичный апи и запусти карго тест
сделай минимальный дифф добавь регрессионный тест и проверь бан ран чек
обнови хендлер передай аборт сигнал в воркер
открой хистори точка эмди и проверь гит дифф

profiles.title: Writing and editing
profiles.audience: Users dictating articles, docs, summaries, social posts, emails, and long-form notes.
normalization_goals: Keep natural Russian intact.
Improve structure markers such as заголовок, список, пункт, цитата, вывод.
Prefer readable paragraphs over code-like replacements.
Avoid changing brand names unless the user has explicitly added dictionary rules.
example_inputs: заголовок итоги недели потом список из трех пунктов

profiles.title: Support and sales
profiles.audience: Support, success, sales, and operations teams dictating replies, CRM notes, call summaries, and follow-ups.
normalization_goals: Normalize common business terms while preserving customer wording.
Support CRM and follow-up vocabulary without developer terms.
Avoid over-polishing facts, numbers, dates, names, and commitments.
example_inputs: добавь заметку в си эр эм
клиент просит инвойс и сроки по эс эл эй

profiles.title: Legal notes
profiles.audience: Users dictating contracts, legal notes, case summaries, and review comments.
normalization_goals: Preserve exact wording and negations.
Normalize only common document markers and safe abbreviations.
Do not infer legal meaning or rewrite clauses.
safety_notes: This profile should not provide legal advice.
Prefer exact transcription over aggressive cleanup.
Numbers, dates, names, and defined terms should remain conservative.
example_inputs: проверь раздел конфиденциальность и не меняй определение сторон

profiles.title: Clinical notes
profiles.audience: Users dictating clinical notes, visit summaries, and patient-facing drafts.
normalization_goals: Preserve exact wording, measurements, medication names, dosages, dates, and negations.
Normalize only safe formatting markers and common note sections.
Avoid guessing clinical terms from ambiguous audio.
safety_notes: This profile should not provide medical advice.
High-confidence transcription is more important than aggressive normalization.
Medication names, dosages, allergies, and negations require conservative handling.
example_inputs: жалобы боль в горле третий день температуры нет
